Keep it open. It will protect you from the owl.
The open umbrella lifts her. Its shadow follows.
The owl is huge, and made of clockwork.
A piece of the owl's wing falls away.
The owl's pursuit ends. He goes back into the darkness.
She is alive, but still suspended between worlds.
Perhaps the owl has only postponed his judgment.
